question: Does client wait advice (tool-type expected return, done, ephemeral, keep_tokens) reduce CPU-offload prefix recomputation for agent sessions beyond the best server-only hold, and under which pool sizes?

platform.gpu: RTX 2080 Ti 11 GB, native Ubuntu 26.04, driver 595.99
platform.vllm: 0.34.0rc1.dev465+ge9281bd93 with the pr-post-response engine-core patch for every arm
platform.admission: q7-admission-a2: byte-identical restore, same boundary, token identity

workload.context_tokens: about 3k to 16k, compaction at 16k or with 10% chance

waits.instant: resampled from captured release-01 waits up to 5 s, median 236 ms

metric: token-weighted recomputed share of eligible reusable prefix tokens on returning turns of hinting sessions

phases.name: stage-a
phases.description: Calibration: LRU at 9 and 12 sessions, 15% long-wait mix

phases.name: phase-1
phases.description: Oracle gate on LRU, 15% long-wait mix, rule fixed in d8a0f1b0

phases.name: phase-1b
phases.description: GPU-aware oracle gate on LRU, 40% long-wait mix, rule fixed in 07a8ed29 and amended in d72f9347

phases.name: sweep
phases.description: Cache-size sweep and candidate, 40% long-wait mix, rule fixed in f0f608ed

rules.phase-1: oracle-lru at least 3 points below the best of lru and auto-lru in each of 3 seeds (sensitivity arms descriptive only)
rules.phase-1b: oracle-gpu-lru at least 3 points below the best of lru and auto300old-lru in each of 3 seeds
rules.sweep: per pool size: oracle-gpu-lru mean lead at least 3 points and lower in at least 4 of 5 seeds; pass runs cand-gpu-lru on the same seeds

excluded_attempts.smoke-*: functional smoke runs before calibration; not evidence
excluded_attempts.probe-n12-p32768-lru-s31002-a1: longer-session calibration probe before sessions were shortened; queue share 29%
excluded_attempts.a-n12-p4096-lru-s31004-a1: refused by the calibration cap; no GPU time
excluded_attempts.l-p2048-lru-s33001-a1: hit the 1,000 s job ceiling; invalid
excluded_attempts.l-p2048-auto-lru-s33001-a1: stopped during model load; terminal reconstructed, 58 s charged
excluded_attempts.x-p4096-auto300old-lru-s33001-a1: stopped deliberately after LRU at 4 GiB recomputed nothing; 22 s charged
